verdict.rationale: Crossplane's official CLI says it supports testing and rendering standalone Composition Functions without access to a Kubernetes cluster running Crossplane. That is a first-party way to exercise infrastructure code away from production, but the evidence is a single brief CLI-doc line. missing for 10: documentation of an automated test framework (assertions, test case definitions, CI integration), testing coverage beyond Composition Functions (e.g. XRDs, managed resources), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
